descripcion_geo: Small volcanic island in the Aegean in the Dodecanese archipelago, 60 km from Miletus.
importancia_estrategica: Rocky island used by Rome as a place of exile.

personajes.descripcion: Son of Zebedee, fisherman of Galilee and close disciple of Jesus. Missioned Samaria with Peter; Tradition later places him in Ephesus, from where he was exiled to Patmos, where he received the Apocalypse.

viajes.nombre: Ephesus and the exile to Patmos

historias.descripcion: Banished by Domitian, John receives visions and writes the book of Revelation.

historias.titulo: The vision of the glorious Christ
historias.descripcion: John sees the Son of Man among seven lampstands; receives the mandate to write.

historias.titulo: The seven letters to the churches
historias.descripcion: John dictates seven letters to the churches of Asia, contained in the Apocalypse.

personajes.descripcion: Exiled on Patmos; recipient of the book of Revelation.
Persecutor of Christians; ordered John's exile to Patmos.
Mediator between Christ and John in the visions of the Apocalypse.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Island of exile where loneliness and persecution became the cradle of the most influential prophetic book of the NT.

cristianismo.descripcion: On Patmos, John receives the last canonical Christian revelation, a cosmic vision of Christ's victory over evil.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: On Patmos, John receives the last canonical Christian revelation, a cosmic vision of Christ's victory over evil.

islam.descripcion: Islam recognizes the divine inspiration of the prophets but does not include the Apocalypse in its canon.
islam.significado_teologico: Islam recognizes the divine inspiration of the prophets but does not include the Apocalypse in its canon.
